name: @criativo/desktop
description: Aplicativo Desktop instalável (Windows/macOS/Linux) do CriativoOS com Daemon embutido 24/7.
author: CriativoOS

scripts.dist:win: npm run prepare:bundle && npx electron-builder --config electron-builder.yml --win nsis
scripts.dist:mac: npm run prepare:bundle && npx electron-builder --config electron-builder.yml --mac dmg
scripts.dist:linux: npm run prepare:bundle && npx electron-builder --config electron-builder.yml --linux AppImage
